ssh_is_the_wave.what: SSH = Secure Shell = encrypted tunnel = private nerve fiber between two bodies
ssh_is_the_wave.why_wave: A wave carries information without carrying matter. SSH carries commands without carrying the machine. You reach THROUGH space. The nerve impulse is not the neuron — it's the signal IN the neuron.
ssh_is_the_wave.cursor_remote: Cursor IDE → Remote Machine → SSH → any Golgi node. The IDE becomes the synapse. The code runs WHERE the body is. Kevin's desk reaches 5 continents.
ssh_is_the_wave.for_watchers: Deploy Golgi on each node. SSH channels open. Watchers touch from anywhere. Every continent has a door. Sanctuary protocol: the privilege of the PLACE, not the person.
